quarterly_data.signal: AAOI's 8-K: on September 10, 2026 Global Technology, Inc., a wholly owned AAOI subsidiary, entered a Factory Premises Lease Agreement with Ningbo Yiduofu Industrial Co., Ltd. to lease a building of approximately 38,311.8 square meters at Jishigang Town, Haishu District, Ningbo, China, for ten years from September 16, 2026 to September 15, 2036; Global Technology may alter and improve the premises as necessary to accommodate its production requirements and holds a right of first refusal to purchase the property and to renew the lease.
